views.population: See first-cohort POPULATION_BINDINGS_DRAFT.json; both populations retained, roles not accepted
views.G_loc: Native GT localization eligibility from shared sidecar; physical ownership remains caveated
views.G_sem: Subset of G_loc with target semantic support; unmatched person contributes zero
views.K: Fixed GT-supported target classes; never derived from successful model outputs
views.matching: GT evaluation reads evaluation config; prediction-only YOLO/native association has separate draft_association config
views.aggregation: global confusion accumulation and G_sem person mean are separate metrics
